description: This file contains SCSS mixins for button styling variants, including default, outline, and size configurations, designed to generate reusable button styles with customizable properties.

methods.name: button-variant
methods.description: Defines styling for button variants with parameters for background, border, colors, hover, active, and disabled states.

methods.name: button-outline-variant
methods.description: Defines outline style variants for buttons with parameters for color, hover states, active states, and disabled styles.

methods.name: button-size
methods.description: Defines size-related styles for buttons, including padding, font size, and border radius.
